name: B10-0097/2024 (Renew) – The case of Bülent Mumay in Türkiye
title: Resolution on the case of Bülent Mumay in Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion. It condemns the 20-month prison sentence given to Turkish journalist Bülent Mumay, which an appeal court upheld on 20 August. It says the charges against him are an attempt to silence the press. It calls on Turkey to review his case, stop targeting journalists, and respect free speech and the rule of law.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its position on Mumay's case.
- It concerns Bülent Mumay, other journalists in Turkey, and exiled Syrian journalists.
- Parliament sends its position to Turkish and European Union leaders; no further action is set.
